title: triticum angustum
intro: Triticum angustum, commonly known as narrow wheat, is a wild species of wheat native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and provide relief from inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Triticum angustum are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and bioactive constituents of this plant.
